bodyText.heading: Do I need health insurance in Germany?
bodyText.text: Every person staying in Germany is obliged to have health insurance. You must have coverage beyond travel insurance in the case of a longer stay. In cooperation with our partner Care Concept AG, we are happy to offer you reasonably priced health insurance. We recommend the tariff “Care College Comfort” with a monthly premium of 32€. Insurance can be taken out either before or two weeks after entering Germany. We will gladly inform you about the contents and conditions of the health insurance.
